package_acceptance_rule: A batch is a work allocation. Each Go package still has one complete atomic artifact inventory, integration decision and acceptance receipt even when several batches contribute.
validation_policy: Prepare the complete owner and dependency inventory before editing; do not pick the next isolated assertion as the batch boundary.
Implement all related producers, consumers, state transitions and removals in the selected coherent unit before final validation.
Capture a combined fail-before regression run; group multiple filters for the same Rust target in one invocation and group compatible crates in one Cargo command.
Run one combined post-change regression pass per target and the required integration/oracle gates. Recompile again only for a meaningful code change, failure or unresolved concern.
Run the required lint/all-target/publication build once at the completed batch boundary, then normal mandatory hook gates. Never bypass hooks.
Update both finding registers and living plans with actual evidence; partial fixes do not close parent findings or packages.
Publication is authorized; follow README.md, exact destinations, actual hook and fresh locked build immediately before every push, then verify remote SHA.
